text:
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout r-402: enabling feature flag `llm_route_v3` at 1% global (cohort-weighted). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/r/402 | contact #eng-releases for ops. :rocket:

maria: ack. backing change window. Can we pin model to `v3.2.1` during this rollout so rollback is deterministic?

kevin: +1 to pin. Also propose EU starts at 0.5% (very conservative) then NA 1% -> 5% global if green. We had latency variance last month.

sophie: monitoring hooks added: synthetic prompt set + p95, errors, and token-cost delta. Alerts: p95 > 180ms OR errors > 0.5% will trigger manual review. Can adjust thresholds if you want tighter.

jamal: release notes published and linked above. I've also added the rollout ID and model-version note in the changelog entry.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-402 acknowledged. Applied pin: `model-version=v3.2.1`. Flag state: 1% global (cohort weighting: EU 0.5%, NA 1%, APAC 0.2%). Canary started.

maria: adding KV cache warmup for the canary path and enabling short-lived prefix caching. Synthetic runner set to 30s cadence.

sophie: initial metrics (3m): global p95=130ms, errors=0.12%, cost delta +3%. EU p95=140ms. Nothing alarming yet.

kevin: fine to proceed but hold EU at 0.5% for 20m. If NA stable after 15m, shift NA to 5%.

[some time later]
sophie: alert: EU cohort p95 spiked to 250ms and saw a small increase in model-compile warnings. Looks like kernel selection fallback for long prompt lengths.

maria: ouch. mobilizing ops. Jamal — can you drain EU cohort for r-402 and pin a rollback target? Use quick rollback to `v3.1.9` for EU only.

jamal: running commands now: `deployctl rollout drain --rollout r-402 --region eu` and `deployctl pin --model v3.1.9 --region eu --reason "kernel fallback causing p95 spike"`. Also opening a tracing slice: trace ids attached to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Action taken: EU cohort drained for r-402. Flag state updated: EU=0%. Pin applied: EU model-version=v3.1.9. Fallback routing enabled to v2.9.4 for heavy/batch requests. Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

sophie: after drain EU metrics look back to baseline: EU p95=120ms, errors=0.05%. NA unchanged. Cost back to normal.

kevin: thanks. Please capture root cause in the post-deploy notes: kernel selection + prompt-length distribution mismatch. I'll open a PR to add a quantization/kernel hint to Optimize recommendations for this workload.

maria: agreed. Also let's add an auto-gate: if EU p95 increases >20% from baseline during future rollouts, auto-drain EU and notify the oncall. Put that in the rollout template.

jamal: done. Added gating rule and annotated the release notes + runbook with the exact command snippets and fallbacks.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-402 status: PARTIALLY_ROLLED_BACK (EU drained). Current global rollout: 1% (NA 1%, APAC 0.2%, EU 0%). Last update ts 1758883410.

maria: schedule quick retro at 10:00 UTC to capture learnings and update the runbook. I'll paste post-deploy notes after retro.

sophie: thanks everyone. I'll keep the synthetic runner going for another hour and then drop cadence to 5min.

kevin: small thumbs up :thumbsup:. We should mention this in the weekly release digest.

jamal: ack — I'll add an item: "EU canary drained due to kernel fallback; pinned to v3.1.9; follow-up PR to Optimize".

maria: closing ops for now. If any new alerts pop, ping here and escalate. :wave:

kevin: great job all.

sophie: :white_check_mark:
